customer_updates.name: KARAN PATEL
customer_updates.text:
Hi All,
We visited this place in the month of March and it was not at all a good experience, we needed to call the operator 3-4 times to update the points as it was showing incorrect. Even if we do strike it was showing an error.

featured_reviews.name: Noel Nadar
featured_reviews.review_text: Visited this place with friends for bowling. It was fun. The bowling alley has quite a groovy vibe! The prices are quite reasonable and are slightly higher on weekends. It is one of the main attractions located in Raghuleela Mall. The music is very loud sometimes but sets in with the lively ambience.

featured_reviews.name: Joshua D'Souza
featured_reviews.review_text: PlayPark is an excellent gaming zone with activities for all age groups! From bowling and the exciting Tomb Raider adventure game to arcade machines and VR setups, there’s something fun for everyone. The place is well-maintained, lively, and gives complete mall gaming area vibes. A perfect spot to hang out with friends or family and enjoy a mix of thrill and relaxation. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: neelam rawat
featured_reviews.review_text: The reason to give one star is, they are not at all taking care of  small kids pathetic service, they don’t care of kids hygiene  problem is also there for an hour I left my kid the staff was busy in chatting and talking to her colleage they dont even now that small kid has done  potty and lu they hand over the kid with full  of potty and lu all clothes were dirty ,then to they  are not At all Interested in kids, they don’t bothered then why the hell the game zone is open close if u charge and u cant take care then shut down the game zone it is not at all tolerated stop doing it

featured_reviews.name: Kaushal Sheth
featured_reviews.review_text: I have visited this game zone with my kid. It is in Raghuleela mall. This Mall is one of the first few mall which was popular back then now it is, not that great due you big malls in town. This game zone is also very old. Games are few. And the points benefit are also very less. I suggest you keep you kid in playzone for hour and you shop thats the only thing kid will enjoy

featured_reviews.name: Zidane Dcosta
featured_reviews.review_text:
It is a good entertainment place for kids as well adults.
For kids :- A variety of arcade games, well organised and clean. Small place but good for a quick visit for a kid.
For adults :- The only place for adults is the bowling alley. Well managed and superb ambience.

featured_reviews.name: Sandeep Kadam
featured_reviews.review_text: Nice gaming zone, several electronic games available but not much well maintained, support staff is good but still space for improvement, dashing car also available, you can enjoy bowling with 4 lanes available, overall nice gaming zone for youngsters and kid's.

featured_reviews.name: Varsha
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a great time at this bowling alley!The ambiance was spot on fun, vibrant, and perfect for hangout with friends. The lighting and music added a really cool vibe.
